title: The Full Pattern - Csinálnék, Csinálnál, Csinálna
grammar: the complete conditional paradigm (-nék/-nál/-na/-nánk/-nátok/-nának) for regular and irregular verbs

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can conjugate a regular verb in the conditional for every person, not just I and you.
I can use the conditional of common irregular verbs like tesz and megy in every person.
